text:
Sara: NexaHealth just escalated — after yesterday's model swap to quantized-rev (q8_2) their rerank precision tanked. Ticket CS-4219. Top-1 recall drop ~18% vs baseline, customer seeing bad UX in search.
Aisha: how urgent? revenue impact?
Sara: P1 for them, paying Dedicated customer, multiple accounts impacted. They say results are "meaningfully worse" and can reproduce on production queries.
Marco: can you paste repro steps / a minimal example?
Sara: yes — they run our embeddings -> dot-product rerank pipeline. Quick repro snippet:
```
# query pipeline
q_emb = embed(query)
docs = search_vectors(q_emb)  # top 100
scores = docs @ q_emb.T
ranked = sort_by(scores)
# compare previous vs current model
```
Old model: embed v1.4 (fp16) — new: embed v1.4-quant (q8_2). Customer compared 500 queries, avg nDCG down 0.14.
Lin: do we have logs or the exact model artifact? config.json from their call would help (temp, norm, quant flags).
Sara: attached logs from the weekend (snip). Their config uses L2 normalize = true, use_kv_cache = false, quant_mode = asymmetric.
Diego: quantization can change embedding geometry — asymmetric q + L2 norm is painful. Could be scale bias shifting dot products. Need to run our eval harness against their query set to confirm.
Marco: decision: we need triage -> quick mitigation -> longer fix. Proposed acceptance criteria to put on product ticket:
- Reproduce customer regression on our side using their 500-query set.
- Identify root cause (quantization mismatch OR pre/post-normalization order).
- Deliver hotfix or recommended config that restores <=2% regression vs baseline.
- Rollout plan: canary 5%, monitor nDCG, auto-fallback to fp16 if rollback triggers.
Lin: scope suggestion: split into two phases — phase 1 (triage + alerting + rollback capability) can be done in 1 sprint. Phase 2 (quantization-aware calibration or re-training) is bigger.
Aisha: product asks for ROI + risk. Customer is on Dedicated reserved capacity; churn risk moderate if unresolved in 2w. Sales flagged for exec attention.
Marco: ok. Prioritize phase 1 as high on backlog. Phase 2 will be prioritized against other infra work — need time estimate from Eng/ML.
Diego: for phase 1 I can run the eval harness and a calibration experiment (rescale embeddings per-dim) — estimate 3 days to confirm, 1 week to produce candidate calibration.
Lin: engineering for rollout+rollback capability — add canary switch and auto-fallback to model pin -> estimate 1 sprint (2w) with one engineer.
Sara: customer has been pinned to fp16 manually but they want a permanent fix. They want roadmap ETA to share with their CTO.
Marco: let's agree to target an initial mitigation (calibration doc + rollback policy) in 7 business days. Final remediation TBD.
triage-bot: Added labels [customer-critical] [rerank-regression] to CS-4219 and linked to product/infra backlog.
Aisha: Can we add automated regression tests to Redwood Optimize so future quant changes run against representative customer sets? This should be a product ask (post-mitigation).
Diego: yes, we can add a per-customer eval harness hook. That is phase 2 work.
Marco: action items:
- Diego: run eval harness on customer set, post results to ticket (ETA 3 days).
- Lin: spec rollback/canary approach and PR config (ETA 1 week).
- Sara/Aisha: keep customer updated and capture signed acceptance (what % nDCG they need to be happy).
- Marco: create product feature ticket for phase 2 (quant-aware calibration + per-customer evals), include acceptance criteria above.
Sara: I'll update CS ticket and ping NexaHealth CTO. I'll include the timeline and the workaround (pin to fp16).
Aisha: tagging legal/ops? They asked for audit logs; we should note any model switching events for compliance.
Marco: good point, Lin please include audit event hooks in the rollback design.
Lin: will do.
Sara: thanks everyone. I'll keep thread updated.
Marco: :eyes: Thanks — I put this on next sprint planning as high priority for triage items.
Diego: :thumbsup: will post findings.
triage-bot: CS-4219 linked -> PROD-8943 (product epic), reminder: standup update tomorrow.
Sara: noted.
